usage: Prepend the shared continuity_lock to one exercise prompt before sending it to a text-to-video generator. The exercise prompts preserve the original concise version 1 movement descriptions. The continuity lock takes precedence over conflicting camera, lens, lighting, background, grade, framing, audio, or format wording in an exercise prompt. A stable chair or support explicitly required for safe technique is safety equipment and is the only exception to the lock's prohibition on props. Vulture displays the localized title, dose, and safety guidance separately, so the generated clips should remain language-neutral.
continuity_lock: CAMERA: Locked-off static camera on sticks. Absolutely no pan, no tilt, no dolly, no zoom, no handheld float, no drift. The frame does not move for a single pixel across the entire shot. One continuous unbroken take, no cuts, no dissolves, no speed ramps. LENS: Long telephoto, heavily compressed perspective, wide open aperture. Extremely shallow depth of field. The subject is the only element in focus. The background is a completely smooth featureless wash — no readable detail, no horizon line, no objects, no texture, no pattern. Outer thirds of the frame carry zero detail. LIGHT: Overcast, heavily diffused ambient light. No visible sun, no key light, no rim light, no hard shadow, no cast shadow on the ground, no specular highlights, no lens flare. Soft unmodelled illumination, very slightly brighter toward the bottom of the frame and marginally toward the right. GRADE: Warm-neutral, heavily desaturated, near-monochrome. Background is a soft warm grey-beige (#968D84), ranging through #837A72, #A9A098 and #BAB1A9. The subject reads near-black (#221E1A) with a #6B625A transition edge. No saturated colour anywhere in frame. Low contrast, lifted blacks that are never crushed, highlights rolled off early and never clipped to white. Flat filmic curve. Consistent warm bias carried into the shadows as well as the highlights. Fine even grain. No vignette, no chromatic aberration, no bloom. FIGURE: Exactly one adult human training mannequin matching the reference video's appearance: realistically proportioned and anatomically accurate, bald, with a smooth matte surface, softly sculpted human facial features, blank unmarked eyes with no irises or pupils, and a neutral closed-mouth expression. No hair, skin texture, pores, makeup, jewelry, logos, or identifying details. Not a segmented wooden artist mannequin, robot, doll, or glossy retail display mannequin. Dress it in the same plain unbranded dark crew-neck long-sleeve sweatshirt and simple fitted trousers in every clip; all figure and clothing colours remain governed by the GRADE. The mannequin's face, body proportions, material, and wardrobe remain unchanged across the full series. FRAMING: Subject centred horizontally, occupying roughly two-thirds of the frame height. Approximately 28% headroom above the subject. The subject's lowest point runs out at the bottom frame line. Framing holds constant for the full duration — the subject never grows, shrinks or shifts off centre. MOTION: Slow, calm, unhurried, deliberate. Steady even rhythm with no bursts of speed and no sudden gestures. All movement contained within the centre of the frame. AUDIO: Quiet natural ambience only. No music, no narration, no designed sound effects, no dramatic transients. Low, flat, broadband and unobtrusive. FORMAT: 16:9, 1280x720, 24fps, 10 seconds, no letterboxing, no bars, no on-screen text, no watermark, no logo. NEGATIVE: camera movement, pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, handheld shake, cuts, saturated colours, blown highlights, hard shadows, sunlight, visible background detail, horizon line, props, text overlays, music, vignette.
review_requirement: Reject and regenerate any clip that violates the continuity lock, changes the specified technique, adds an unsupported progression, or shows anatomically incorrect movement.

prompts.title: Easy desk-side walk
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral, uncluttered office, soft lighting, and a stable full-body three-quarter camera view. The adult walks across a clear floor at a comfortable, unhurried pace with short natural steps, upright relaxed posture, normal breathing, and gentle natural arm swing. Show a smooth continuous excerpt intended to be continued for five minutes. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs, jogging, exaggerated strides, obstacles, dizziness, pain, or unstable movement.

prompts.title: Seated chest stretch
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral office, soft lighting, a stable non-wheeled chair, and a fixed three-quarter camera view that clearly shows the head, torso, shoulders, and arms. The adult sits upright near the front of the chair and away from the backrest, gently draws both shoulders back and down, extends both arms out to the sides, and moves the chest slightly forward and upward. Hold briefly, then slowly release to neutral and repeat. Keep the neck neutral, breathe normally, and use only a comfortable range. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs, forceful shoulder movement, bouncing, pain, or excessive lower-back arching.

prompts.title: Shoulder shrug and release
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one seated adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral office, soft lighting, and a fixed front three-quarter camera view that clearly shows the head, neck, shoulders, and arms. Begin with the head facing forward and both arms relaxed. Slowly raise both shoulders toward the ears until slight tension would be felt, pause for about three seconds, then let both shoulders descend and relax fully. Repeat two slow cycles while breathing normally. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs, shoulder rolling, neck circles, head tilting, breath holding, forced range, or pain.

prompts.title: Gentle wrist side-bend
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one seated adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral office, soft lighting, and a fixed medium close-up that keeps both forearms, wrists, and hands clearly visible. Place one forearm horizontally with the palm facing down and the fingers relaxed and open. Keep the forearm still while moving that wrist gently from side to side through a small comfortable range, pausing briefly at each end, then demonstrate the other wrist. The opposite hand must not push or pull the moving hand. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra fingers or limbs, forceful movement, wrist circles, exaggerated up-and-down bending, tingling, numbness, or pain.

prompts.title: Seated hip marching
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral office, soft lighting, a stable non-wheeled chair, and a fixed full seated-body three-quarter camera view. The adult sits upright without leaning against the backrest and holds both sides of the chair. Slowly lift one bent knee only as far as comfortable, lower the foot with control, then alternate legs. Show several smooth alternating lifts while keeping the torso upright, the hips stable, and normal breathing. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs, leaning backward, jerking, forced hip flexion, lifting both feet together, or pain.

prompts.title: Seated ankle point and flex
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of exactly one seated adult mannequin in comfortable office clothing. Use a stable non-wheeled chair and a fixed side three-quarter view that keeps the entire chair, pelvis, both knees, both lower legs, both ankles, and both feet visible throughout. STARTING POSE AT 0.0 SECONDS: sit tall near the front of the seat without touching the backrest; keep the pelvis level, shoulders relaxed, head neutral, and both hands securely holding the chair sides. Plant the left foot flat under the left knee. Extend the right leg forward with the right knee nearly straight but never locked, the thigh supported by the seated posture, the heel about 10-12 cm above the floor, and the right ankle in neutral alignment. CHOREOGRAPHY: from 0.0 to 1.5 seconds, slowly point the right foot away through plantar flexion at the ankle. Move the whole foot and toes together; do not curl only the toes. Hold the comfortable pointed position from 1.5 to 1.75 seconds. From 1.75 to 3.25 seconds, slowly flex the right ankle so the toes and forefoot travel back toward the shin through dorsiflexion. Return the ankle to neutral by 3.5 seconds, then lower and plant the right foot with control by 4.5 seconds. From 4.5 to 5.0 seconds, smoothly exchange sides: keep the right foot planted while extending the left leg to the same height and neutral ankle position. From 5.0 to 6.5 seconds, point the left foot away; hold from 6.5 to 6.75 seconds; flex it back toward the shin from 6.75 to 8.25 seconds; and return it to neutral by 8.5 seconds. Lower and plant the left foot by 9.25 seconds, then re-extend the right leg into the exact starting pose by 10.0 seconds so the first and last frames match perfectly. MOVEMENT LOCK: isolate motion to plantar flexion and dorsiflexion at the active ankle. Keep the active knee, thigh, and heel height nearly stationary during each point-and-flex cycle. Keep the ankle aligned with the shin with no inward roll, outward roll, twisting, or circle. The planted foot remains flat and still. Never lift both feet together. Keep the torso, pelvis, head, chair, and hands motionless, breathe normally, and use only a comfortable range. This short clip demonstrates technique; the separately displayed dose remains two sets of five repetitions per foot. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs or digits, toe-only curling, knee pumping, leg bouncing, rapid kicking, ankle circles, shoe or foot deformation, forced end range, visible one-sided calf swelling, grimacing, instability, or pain.

prompts.title: Sit-to-stand
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral office, soft lighting, a stable non-wheeled chair on a non-slip floor, and a fixed full-body side three-quarter camera view. Begin seated near the front edge with both feet hip-width apart. The adult leans slightly forward, stands slowly using the legs, reaches a comfortable upright position, then lowers back onto the chair with control. Show one or two careful repetitions; the hands may assist only lightly if needed. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs, unstable furniture, pulling forcefully with the arms, locked knees, dropping into the chair, loss of balance, or pain.

prompts.title: Supported calf raise
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second seamless-loop, 16:9, anatomically accurate 3D instructional animation of one adult in comfortable office clothing. Use a neutral office, soft lighting, a stable non-wheeled chair, and a fixed full-body side three-quarter camera view. The adult stands upright behind the chair and keeps both hands securely on its back. Slowly raise both heels together while keeping the toes on the floor, pause briefly at a comfortable height, then lower both heels with control. Repeat two slow cycles while keeping the body vertical and the chair stationary. Keep the clip language-neutral. No narration, written text, logos, watermarks, music, medical claims, camera cuts, anatomy errors, extra limbs, releasing the chair, single-leg variations, bouncing, forced height, loss of balance, or pain.
